Synthex Corp (NASDAQ: SYNX) Reports Second Quarter Fiscal 2027 Financial Results

SAN MATEO, Calif. — Synthex Corp (NASDAQ: SYNX) today announced financial results for its second quarter of fiscal year 2027, the three months ended July 31, 2026.

“Our platform continued to gain traction with enterprise customers in the second quarter of fiscal 2027,” said the Company’s Chief Executive Officer. “We are pleased with the pace of adoption across our subscription business and remain focused on durable, profitable growth.”

Business Outlook

For the third quarter of fiscal 2027, Synthex Corp expects total revenue in the range of $430 million to $445 million, and non-GAAP diluted earnings per share in the range of $1.20 to $1.28.
